source_en: Cleaned apiary frames. Going to my room.
Building site shift done. To the crew flat.
Picking up more smoke canisters.
From the apiary. Only the bees now.
Checking the sugar water supplies.
Seeking a medical check for my head.
Said goodbye to the hives. Going home.
Returning to my assigned residence.
Looking for the master. Not at the hives.
Allergic to bee stings. Seeing a doctor.
Collecting my apiary cooperative pension.
Coaching junior debate. Fast talkers win.
Day shift at the building site. Busy.
New to the city from Zugdidi.
Selling the master's hives. Never liked bees.
Taking over the apiary. I am master now.
Retiring at forty-five. Off to the coast.
Lost. Never been to the east side.
Hello. I... have my papers. Somewhere. The bees are... very quiet today.
I am returning. The master says I am... finished for today.
The hives are melting. But... there is no heat at all.
The air tastes like... burnt sugar and metal. My head is heavy.
I can hear the queen. She is... under my skin now.
There is no more Emzar. Only... the swarm. The sky is a dead eye.
Thank you. I... will go now. Slowly. Very slowly.
The buzzing... it is getting louder inside. Goodbye.
We will all... be... together soon. Very soon.
White walls. The bees prefer... white. This is... acceptable.
I will wait here. I am very good... at waiting. Quieter here.
Oh. The buzzing... it is very loud... and then... it stops.
The queen... she is calling me... home... Everything turns gold...
Where are you coming from?
The apiary. East side. I cleaned frames. The bees were... quiet. Good day.
The apiary. The hives are... wrong. The site closed. So... only the bees.
The hives. I went to... say goodbye. The master was not there.
The honey cooperative, west district. I am... the master there. I run it.
The apiary. Master Tengiz sent me home early. He said... rest.
Home. My mother's flat. I have always... lived with her. Quiet.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
My chest is... tight. Dust from the site. The foreman says so.
My head is heavy. Full of... honey. And I cough. Something dark.
I do not sleep. When I do... I wake up wet. Ears ring.
No. My chest is... clear. I do not work at any site.
My head is... light. Very clear. I have not needed... any doctor.
Nothing. I am... forty now. The body... settles at forty.
The bees are... very restless today. More than usual.
You do not smell like smoke. That is... unusual. In a good way.
There is a buzzing in this booth. You hear it? Lower than bees.
My head is... heavier lately. I think it is filling with something.
The queen is very close now. I can feel her. Through the walls.
Do not worry about me. I am... being taken care of. The swarm comes.
